basic_info.description: Located on the lively 19th Avenue corridor, this move-in ready San Francisco home offers a rare combination of convenience, charm, and opportunity. While the property reflects a classic, timeless style, it provides spacious, light-filled living areas that are ready for everyday comfort.    The functional kitchen and bathrooms serve today's needs, with potential to personalize and modernize at your own pace. Generously sized bedrooms offer flexibility, and the private yard is perfect for gardening, relaxing, or hosting friends and family.    Enjoy unparalleled access to public transit, shops, restaurants, and city amenities, making commuting and errands effortless. Ideal for buyers seeking a home that's ready to live in while offering the opportunity to add their own updates, this property combines location, convenience, and lifestyle in one vibrant San Francisco neighborhood.
